questions: Should groups not present in the DataFrame be silently skipped, or should the function raise an error or warn?
If a group has no data (empty after filtering), should it be skipped entirely (no color consumed) or still consume a color from the cycle?
Should the x-axis (date ordinal) range be automatically scaled to the union of all groups' dates, or per-group if axes are shared?
Does 'shared axes' mean all groups are plotted on the same Axes object (as in reference), or is there an option for separate subplots?
Should the date-to-ordinal conversion handle timezone-aware datetime objects, or assume naive dates?
Is the order of plotting groups (and thus color assignment) strictly the order in the 'groups' parameter, or alphabetical/DataFrame order?
If the DataFrame contains groups outside those listed in the 'groups' parameter, should they be excluded from the plot?
Should the function add a legend to distinguish groups by color?
